name: Fiore Verritti
original_name: フィオーレ・ベルリッティ
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c9016]Carina's[/url] mother and the wife of Fabious. Graceful and refined, she's a role model for Carina. Fione comes from a lineage with a deep relationship with dragons, thanks to her bloodline Carina was able to learn magic.
translation: [url=https://vndb.org/c9016]Carina's[/url] mother and the wife of Fabious. Graceful and refined, she's a role model for Carina. Fione comes from a lineage with a deep relationship with dragons, thanks to her bloodline Carina was able to learn magic.
